item.title: Niall Horan Announces Dates For 2027 North American Dinner Party Live Tour
item.description:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! Welcome to our latest update. We've got some exciting news for all you Niall Horan fans out there. The former One Direction member is gearing up for his 2027 Dinner Party live tour, and we've got all the details you need to know."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The tour will kick off on March 17th at the Grand Casino Arena in St. Paul, Minnesota, and will hit 26 arenas across North America over a two-month period. You can catch Niall Horan in cities like Detroit, Chicago, Toronto, Brooklyn, and many more, before the tour wraps up on May 29th at Rogers Arena in Vancouver."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Tickets will go on sale starting with a Citi presale on May 12th, followed by an artist presale on May 13th, and a general onsale on May 15th. Mark your calendars, because you won't want to miss out on this opportunity to see Niall Horan live."
[Short music transition]
Host: "And that's not all - Niall Horan will also be performing on the plaza at New York's Rockefeller Center on June 12th as part of the Citi Concert Series on The Today Show. Plus, he's got two co-headlining stadium shows lined up with Thomas Rhett in Nashville and Hershey, Pennsylvania, and will be taking his tour to the UK and EU later this year."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So far, we've heard two singles from Niall Horan's upcoming fourth solo album, 'Dinner Party', which drops on June 5th. Get ready to sing along to his new music live on tour. That's all for now - stay tuned for more updates, and we'll see you on the road!"
[Outro music plays]
